instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: The ((government)) is challenged by the opposition.
atoms.finishSound: The government is challenged by the opposition.

atoms.b: Leaving the dog home alone had ((disastrous)) consequences.
atoms.finishSound: Leaving the dog home alone had disastrous consequences.

atoms.b: A ((profession)) of love is the climax of many romantic comedies.
atoms.finishSound: A profession of love is the climax of many romantic comedies.

atoms.b: The new ((restaurant)) in town opened today.
atoms.finishSound: The new restaurant in town opened today.

atoms.b: She confessed for the sake of her ((conscience)).
atoms.finishSound: She confessed for the sake of her conscience.
